## Historical execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations refer to the supplied expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/`. Their corresponding archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r2--fixed_h0.tar.gz`; each member is `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/fixed_h0/H0/` plus the relative file path cited below. Line numbers are those of the original expanded files.

### Shipboard compartment: development `commons_118588033`

Step 3 code constructs a painted deck and bulkheads, overhead beams and pipes, a three-tier rack of rods, canvas, filleted mattresses and pillows, cabinets, lockers, equipment, a chair turned 12 degrees, and suspended lamps. These are assembled primitive parts, not evidence that every joint physically contacts another part [X0904, `development/commons_118588033/steps/003/build.py`, lines 31–63, 87–107, 111–171, 181–189].

The code assigns principled-material roughness, bright-color emission, and a noise-driven floor bump. It specifies a 27.5 mm camera, five area lights, a dim world, Cycles, denoising, 64 samples and 384 × 512 output [X0904, same file, lines 191–233]. The reference metadata also says 384 × 512 [X0906, `development/commons_118588033/task.json`, lines 2–5]. **Actual logs**, however, show 16/16 samples for both steps 2 and 3, each finishing and saving a PNG and blend file, with empty stderr [X0903, `development/commons_118588033/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0905, `development/commons_118588033/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]. The supplied record does not establish a selection or quality assessment for this scene.

### Kitchen corner: selection `commons_133800864`

Step 1 failed before rendering: a sink rim fillet radius exceeded half its smallest dimension. Step 2 clamped rounded-box radii but failed because the world was `None`; both results have null images [X0912, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0913, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/002/build.py`, lines 17–19; X0914, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7]. Step 3 creates a world if necessary and successfully finishes a 16-sample render, saving PNG and blend, despite the code specifying 48 samples [X0915, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/003/build.py`, lines 274–297; X0916, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7].

The successful code models cabinetry, 43 angled blind slats, a layered pseudo-basin, faucet, separate blender base/cup/control, pitcher and holder parts; the jug is a 64-point-per-ring mesh and the towel two subdivided, solidified grids [X0915, same build file, lines 21–118, 184–237]. Procedural noise, ramps and bump are intended for granite, cotton and paper; name-matched parts receive metallic settings [X0915, lines 138–171, 205–215, 252–265]. The camera is at `(-1.74,-2.90,2.18)`, lens 79, with two area lights and AgX [X0915, lines 267–297].

`selected.json` records step 3, although the record’s `selected` field is null [X0909, `selection/commons_133800864/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0908, `selection/commons_133800864/record.json`, lines 53–57]. The record reports valid and functional passes for “blender base,” but explicitly limits these to structural/edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Its overall score is 0.4241, not an independent visual acceptance [X0908, lines 16–34].

### Industrial kitchen: selection `commons_138420790`

Step 1 failed on a missing world; step 2 added a world and rendered successfully at 16 samples [X0923, `selection/commons_138420790/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0924, `selection/commons_138420790/steps/002/build.py`, lines 189–205; X0925, `selection/commons_138420790/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7]. Step 3 is recorded as selected, but **no step 3 execution result is supplied**, so its successful rendering cannot be independently established here [X0920, `selection/commons_138420790/selected.json`, lines 1–3].

The step 3 code places tiled floor boxes, cabinet and oven components, an island with layered sink, swept faucet and separate lever, hood and multi-part kettle [X0926, `selection/commons_138420790/steps/003/build.py`, lines 17–23, 74–156]. It assigns procedural wood and plaster using world-space bounding-box tests, not contact tests; its level 46 mm camera, four lights, Cycles 48 samples and 384 × 512 settings are code intent [X0926, lines 160–245]. The record reports complete, valid and functional passes for “chrome faucet,” overall 0.4791, while leaving semantic completeness and support/collision truth null [X0919, `selection/commons_138420790/record.json`, lines 16–34].

**Quality boundary:** No images are attached. Neither coordinates, AABBs, successful rendering, reported metrics nor structural passes establish physical connections or image fidelity. A completed render may still be a poor reconstruction; the documented exceptions are technical failures, not visual judgments.
